notes.title: Indie classic Super Hexagon gets a big free Neo update out now
notes.content:
Super Hexagon, a true indie gem classic from Terry Cavanagh has a big update out now and it has also become Steam Deck Verified with it.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/indie-classic-super-hexagon-gets-a-big-free-neo-update-out-now

notes.title: Trading cards, 50% off sale, and a new game coming soon
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just a quick announcement to let you all know:

 - I have a new game coming out this Summer that I'm really excited about. It's called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861540/Dicey_Dungeons/]Dicey Dungeons[/url], and I think it's the best game I've ever worked on. Consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861540/Dicey_Dungeons/]wishlisting[/url] if you'd like to get a reminder when it's out!

 - I finally added trading cards to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/221640/Super_Hexagon/]Super Hexagon[/url]. Hope you like them! (I've also added some for my other game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/70300/VVVVVV/]VVVVVV[/url]).

 - Both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/221640/Super_Hexagon/]Super Hexagon[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/70300/VVVVVV/]VVVVVV[/url] are currently in a 50% off week-long sale!

Thanks for reading <3

- Terry
